Name: Gera, Son of Ehud
Summary: Son of Ehud, named among the sons of Ehud and among those who removed the inhabitants of Geba.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:5; 1 Chronicles 8:7: Son of Ehud, named among the sons of Ehud and among those who removed the inhabitants of Geba.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Gera stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
